algorithm.convergence_criteria: No reproducible cluster convergence, graph seed, random-walk stopping rule, SVM calibration, nested SVR selection, Apriori stability, PCA variance criterion, or policy monitoring criterion is reported.
software: Python, NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, NetworkX, igraph, seaborn, mlxtend, MATLAB-style SVM snippets, and Excel files appear in the paper/code appendix; no bundle was executed.

assumptions: Treat drug-identification reports as a usable but imperfect proxy, zone aggregation as acceptable, recent years as more informative, spread as local, missing data as average, and similarity as a basis for peer borrowing.

Separate source hypothesis, classifier label, fitted prediction, association rule, factor correlation, PCA component, equivalent policy surrogate, forecast map, strategy recommendation, and memo claim.
models.computational_cost: The authors mention repeated trials, off-the-shelf speed, and dimensional burden, but report no runtime, hardware, memory, iteration count, or scaling analysis.

details: Claims are bounded by five states, 2010-2017 reports, 2010-2016 ACS factors, 100 zones, 200 km peer radius, and 2018-2019 prediction horizon.
No stationary distribution, stable origin process, or policy equilibrium is estimated; the walk and SVR are finite simulations/forecasts.
NFLIS/ACS inputs, zone matrices, graphs, code fragments, and model steps are described, but frozen executable inputs and environment are not included with the paper.
No joint uncertainty propagates clustering, missingness, similarity, graph direction, pseudo-labels, hyperparameters, association rules, PCA, or strategy equivalence.

constraints: Preserve drug/county/zone/year, report denominator, distance unit, theta, k, peer count, graph orientation, random-walk trial, SVM label path, SVR split, association thresholds, PCA version, scenario bound, horizon, and authority.

Do not promote similarity to exchangeability, graph direction to trafficking flow, pseudo-label to ground truth, association to cause, equivalent alpha edit to intervention effect, or map pattern to legal/traffic explanation.
